content:
Meta's streak at the top of the U.S. and Canada App Store charts is still going strong, as downloads of its AI helper Muse have surpassed 5 million, according to data from Sensor Tower. Here's the full breakdown.

Muse has now spent 12 consecutive days at the top of the U.S. App Store charts.

Meta launched Muse in the U.S. three weeks ago, and it immediately knocked ChatGPT off the top spot on the U.S. App Store's free app charts.

Kara Lee, Senior Insights Analyst at Sensor Tower, estimates that Muse has now surpassed 5 million downloads as of today. That pace is significantly faster than ChatGPT, Grok, and Claude, which Sensor Tower notes took 56 days, 103 days, and 492 days respectively to hit the same milestone.

Muse is Meta's agentic AI assistant that can browse the web and carry out tasks on behalf of users, including sending emails, shopping, filling out forms, and booking travel.

Sensor Tower added that Claude and Grok were iOS-only for their first 5 days. By contrast, Meta's Muse app is available on both iOS and Android platforms, though it is currently limited to the U.S. and Canada.

And after five minutes, more than half of them deleted the app.

The report added that while Meta's Muse app appears to have generated significant public interest, Meta's own advertising push is likely one of the key reasons behind its swift uptake.

Sensor Tower noted, "Meta began ramping up advertising for Muse on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, driving a 73% day-over-day surge in downloads that day," adding:

Sensor Tower also noted that during the week of September 21 to September 27, Muse ranked among the top 15 brands in the U.S. by ad exposure.
